items.q: Is it only prosecco on the Silverline prosecco cruise?
items.a: Yes. Prosecco is the one unlimited drink; snacks are for sale and you can't bring your own.

items.q: How long is the Silverline prosecco cruise?
items.a: About 1 hour, with unlimited prosecco for the whole 60 minutes. It leaves at 16:30, 19:30 and 21:00 from Dock 11 at Elizabeth Bridge.

items.q: Where is the best spot for Parliament photos?
items.a: The upper deck: it is the spot for photos of the lit-up Parliament.

items.q: Is the Silverline prosecco cruise a party?
items.a: A warm-up: party songs from the loudspeakers, pitched as a pre-party before a night out. Adults only (18+).

title.text: No-Frills Evening Sightseeing Cruise From Elizabeth Bridge

tested.pop_html: I rode this cruise myself. Most of the photos in the review are my own.What I checked: deck views, commentary, drinks and value for money. Full review ↓

pills.label: Evening · 16:30–21:15
pills.pop_html: Sailings at 11:00, 14:00, 15:30, 16:30, 17:00, 17:20, 18:20, 18:40, 19:40, 20:00, 21:00 and 21:15. 60 minutes.📍 Dock 11, Elizabeth Bridge: Pest side next to Elizabeth Bridge, a short walk from Ferenciek tere metro. Comfortable indoor meeting point.

pills.label: 15-Language Audio
pills.pop_html: Audio guide in 15 languages.Silverline does not publish the list of languages.

pills.label: No wheelchair access
pills.pop_html: ♿ Wheelchair: ✕ the boat has no wheelchair access🎟️ Kids: free under 4, full price from 4; no dogs except service dogs

pills.label: No drink included
pills.pop_html: No drink in the ticket price: even water costs extra. There is a bar on board.

pills.label: No-frills sightseeing
pills.pop_html: A plain sightseeing hour with no drink included. Heated main deck. The upper deck costs €5 more and has a roof with columns that block part of the view. Infants up to 3 ride free.

pills.label: Upper Deck +€5
pills.pop_html: The panoramic upper deck costs €5 more. It has a roof with columns that block part of the view. For photos, the front seats and the open-air section are better.

pills.label: Heated main deck
pills.pop_html: The main deck is heated. 14 sailings a day, so it is easy to fit in.

best_for.pick_html: for a cheap, central evening loop with frequent departures right by Elizabeth Bridge.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a drink included or the best reviews: drinks cost extra, and it rates 3.8 on Viator.

items.q: Can I book on the day?
items.a: Yes, same-day booking works, and with 14 sailings a day from 11:00 to 21:15 it is easy to fit in. Evening slots in December can sell out, though.
